shipped_originals.title_o: Emergence of verbal responses using instructive feedback: A replication and extension

blind_target.authors: Shillingsburg, M. A., Frampton, S. E., Cleveland, S. A., & Cariveau, T.
blind_target.title: Clinical applications of procedures to promote the emergence of untrained intraverbal relations with children with autism.
blind_target.evidence_quote: Shillingsburg, Frampton, Cleveland, and Cariveau (2018) taught listener and tact by feature, name-feature intraverbal, and feature-name intraverbal responses across sets and reported emergence of responses that were not directly trained for 6 individuals diagnosed with autism spectrum disorder (ASD). The current study was a systematic replication with the addition of instructive feedback (IF) with 2 children diagnosed with ASD.
blind_target.outcome_quote: We observed increased correct responses for related verbal responses; replicating Shillingsburg et al.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Abstract explicitly states replication of the earlier trained/untrained verbal-response finding. Target citation copied from publisher reference list.

shipped_originals.title_o: Reducing the Racial Achievement Gap: A Social-Psychological Intervention

blind_target.evidence_quote: Though low-cost value affirmation interventions have been shown to reduce achievement gaps in some classroom settings, these findings have not been consistently replicated. In this study, we test the efficacy of this intervention among a new sample of students enrolled in a community college in the Midwest.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Overall, we find little evidence of a positive effect of this one-time affirmation of social identity.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Overall verdict indicates little evidence for the intervention effect. Abstract does not identify the original paper; no citation guessed.
